title: Release and PR Quality Gate
description: Bind an exact change or build to required Browser QA suites and publish an auditable pass, fail, or needs-review decision.
setup_prompt: Use Release and PR Quality Gate with my proven Browser QA suites. Bind the exact change and tested build, require complete selected suite results, derive the decision from my policy, and publish only to authorized destinations with real receipts.

setup_inputs.label: Manual, authenticated API, PR, or release trigger
Repository change, build, and environment identity mapping
Blocking, incomplete, rerun, and review policy
Authorized status, report, and notification destinations

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks API trigger
recommended_tools.purpose: Start the saved gate route from an authenticated CI or repository event

recommended_tools.name: GitHub CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Resolve authorized change context and publish an approved check or summary
